tools.name: spawn
tools.description: Start a child session to work on part of your task in parallel. The child is a separate agent with its own git worktree and branch of this repository, and it does not see your conversation, so `prompt` must say everything it needs. Returns at once with the child's id and branch while the child works in the background; call wait_for to get its report. Children cannot spawn children, and a task has a limit on children (5 unless the user changed it).

model.description: Model, in the provider's own naming. Defaults to yours on your provider, otherwise to that provider's default.

permission_mode.description: What the child may do without asking; at most your own mode. Defaults to yours.

oneOf.description: Reads only; every write or command is refused.
Asks before every write or command.
Edits files freely; asks before commands.
Does anything without asking.

prompt.description: Complete instructions for the child: the goal, the files and context it needs, constraints, and what to report back when done. The child sees nothing else of your conversation.

provider.description: Vendor CLI that runs the child, e.g. "claude" or "codex"; must be one of this task's providers. Defaults to yours.

task.description: Short label for the child's work, shown to the user in the task tree, e.g. "Fix the flaky auth tests".

branch.description: Branch the child works on, in this repository.

child.description: The new child; pass it to send, status and wait_for.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a follow-up prompt to a child: a correction, the next step, or a reply to its report. An idle child starts its next turn on it at once; a working child gets it after its current turn ends, in the order sent, and `queued` is then true. Either way its report comes through wait_for. To unblock a child waiting on a question or approval, use answer instead.

child.description: The child, as returned by spawn.

text.description: The message, as a prompt to the child.

queued.description: True when the message waits behind the child's running turn; false when the child started a turn on it.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Snapshot of your children: each one's task, branch, status, latest report, and the questions and approval requests waiting for your answer. Returns at once; use wait_for to block until something changes.

children.description: Children to report on. Defaults to all of yours.

items.description: Identifies a session; a ULID string, opaque to receivers.

children.description: One entry per child, oldest first.

branch.description: Branch the child works on, in this repository.

last_report.description: Summary of its latest finished turn; absent before the first one ends.

open_questions.description: Its questions and approval requests waiting for your answer.

items.description: A child's question or approval request that waits for an answer.

oneOf.description: The child asked a question. Answer with `question_id` and `text`, or `choice` when it lists choices.

choices.description: Answers to pick from by position; empty for a free-text answer.

oneOf.description: The child wants to run a tool call it may not run unasked. Answer with `approval_id` and `decision`.

summary.description: What the child wants to do.

status.description: `running` while it works or waits on you, `idle` when its turn ended, `needs_you` when it waits on the user, `error` when it cannot continue.

oneOf.description: Waiting for a prompt.
The agent is working, or waiting for its primary session to answer an approval or question.
Blocked on a user: an approval or question routed or escalated to the user, or a failed turn to act on.
Cannot continue without intervention.
Put away by a user; read-only.
Handed off to another host; read-only here.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Block until a child needs you: it finished a turn (`report`), or it asked a question or requested an approval that waits for your answer (`request`). Returns the oldest such event that no earlier wait_for returned, at once if one is already waiting; each event is returned once. Pass `child` to wait for that child only, or omit it to wait for any. Returns `timeout` when `timeout_secs` pass first, and `idle` at once when no awaited child is working and nothing waits for you.

child.description: Wait for this child only. Omit to wait for any of yours.

oneOf.description: A child finished a turn and is idle again, or stopped on an error.
Waiting for a prompt.
The agent is working, or waiting for its primary session to answer an approval or question.
Blocked on a user: an approval or question routed or escalated to the user, or a failed turn to act on.
Cannot continue without intervention.
Put away by a user; read-only.
Handed off to another host; read-only here.

summary.description: The child's final message of that turn, or what went wrong.

oneOf.description: A child is blocked on a question or approval request waiting for your answer.
The child asked a question. Answer with `question_id` and `text`, or `choice` when it lists choices.

choices.description: Answers to pick from by position; empty for a free-text answer.

oneOf.description: The child wants to run a tool call it may not run unasked. Answer with `approval_id` and `decision`.

summary.description: What the child wants to do.

oneOf.description: Nothing happened within `timeout_secs`; your children are still working.
No awaited child is working and nothing waits for you, so nothing would happen.

tools.name: answer
tools.description: Answer a question or approval request that a child put to you, unblocking it. For a question pass `question_id` with `text`, or `choice` when it lists choices; for an approval pass `approval_id` with `decision`. Your answer is final and the child acts on it, so escalate instead when the decision belongs to the user. Fails with `already_resolved` when someone answered first.

approval_id.description: The approval request to decide. Pass it with `decision`.

choice.description: Position of the chosen answer in the question's `choices`, from 0.

decision.description: `allow` runs the tool call once, `deny` refuses it.

oneOf.description: Run the tool call once.
Refuse the tool call.

question_id.description: The question to answer. Pass it with `text` or `choice`.

tools.name: escalate
tools.description: Hand a question or approval request that a child put to you over to the user, when the decision is theirs rather than yours: product or scope choices, credentials, anything destructive or outside the task. The child stays blocked until the user answers. Pass `question_id` or `approval_id`, and a `note` with what the user should know to decide.

approval_id.description: The approval request to hand over.

note.description: What the user should know to decide: your view, the options, the risk.
